english.title: Drive / leave a vehicle when it did not comply with lighting requirements at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[drove]_
(B)_[left]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport which did not comply with the lighting requirements which applied on those parts of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments applied, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEFICIENCY IN LIGHTING..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6(2) and 2(2) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
